name: よかれと思ってやったのに ～男たちの『失敗学』裁判～
original_name: よかれと思ってやったのに ～男たちの『失敗学』裁判～
overview:
A fresh take on the courtroom drama, this series brings to trial cases where actions taken by men with the best of intentions have caused immense stress to women and those around them.

From the ‘crime of lack of understanding’—organising a self-righteous surprise date—to the ‘crime of failure to communicate’—announcing a transfer as a fait accompli without first consulting one’s wife—cases involving a ‘lack of emotional etiquette’ that everyone can relate to are put on trial.
